name: marriagebureau
description: Single Hostinger Node.js entrypoint for Doctor Marriage Bureau frontends with API proxy.

scripts.admin:ci: npm run admin:install && npm --prefix "Admin Panel Frontend" run ci
scripts.user:ci: npm run user:install && npm --prefix "New User Panel Frontend" run ci
scripts.mobile:ci: npm run mobile:install && npm --prefix "DMB Mobile App" run ci
scripts.admin:build: npm run admin:install && npm --prefix "Admin Panel Frontend" run build
scripts.user:build: npm run user:install && npm --prefix "New User Panel Frontend" run build
scripts.mobile:build:web: npm run mobile:install && npm --prefix "DMB Mobile App" run build:web
scripts.hostinger:build: npm run user:build && npm run admin:build
